page.notes: The left margin carries three notes: "a" (In Coloss. 3. Hom. 2.), "b" (De Trinitate lib. 11. pag. 173.) and "m" (Arausican. Conc. 2. Can. 12, & 20. apud Binium.). The mark "b" stands in the text beside a note that is not visible in this part; the note for "k" is not visible in this part either. Right-hand words are cut off at the scan edge and are given only as far as visible. Left and right edges of the column are cut off, so several line beginnings are fragments; the first line of the text is a continuation. The superscript 1 before "Hilarius" has no matching note in this part. The running head shows only its last letters. The right side strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
